bio: Jack LaSure is the founder of Wilder Customs, bringing together his passion for classic trucks and 4x4s with an appreciation for craftsmanship and timeless design.

Jack's interest in classic 4x4s began with his love for Toyota Land Cruisers. Over time, that passion grew into Wilder Customs, where he now helps clients buy and sell classic trucks and 4x4s. He takes a personal approach to every vehicle, focusing on representing it well, understanding its history, and making the experience straightforward and enjoyable for both buyers and sellers.

Jack's background in the automotive world began before Wilder Customs. He previously owned and operated Next Level Auto Detailing in Asheville, North Carolina, followed by Next Level Mobile Auto Detailing in Charleston, South Carolina. Those businesses gave him early experience working directly with vehicles and customers and ultimately helped lay the foundation for what would become Wilder Customs.

Outside of Wilder Customs, Jack serves as Director of Operations at Landrum Tables, a Charleston-based custom furniture company that creates handcrafted furniture from reclaimed Charleston lumber. His work there has further shaped his appreciation for craftsmanship, history, and thoughtful design — values that carry over naturally into his approach to classic vehicles.
Whether it's a piece of Charleston history or a classic 4x4, Jack has always been drawn to things with character, craftsmanship, and a story worth preserving.
